scope: local art-selection proposal only; NOT the backend Look schema

fields.base: exact manifest base ID; own skeleton proportions
fields.skin: this export skin_palette.json ID, requires explicit UI mapping
fields.hair: per-base hair_library.hair key, or none; null retains default
fields.facial: per-base facial keys, additive, not a hairstyle replacement
fields.tints: hair palette for hair, cloth palette for top/bottom/shoes/accent; only existing masks have a visible effect
fields.accessories: per-base accessory keys; at most one per exact socket; composed triangle gate required

compatibility: No cross-base clothing swaps are declared. Only existing per-base files are catalogued.
wire_handoff: runtime_part_map.json; aliases remain null until exact IDs and renderer support are integrated

tint_preview.space: linear RGB, masks non-color; source textures albedo/emission sRGB
tint_preview.mask0: R skin, G hair, B top, A bottom
tint_preview.formula: sequential out = lerp(current, tint * min(luminance(current) / max(0.03, luminance(region_default)), 1.6), mask)
tint_preview.source: scripts/v2_render.py:toon_material; a Blender preview, not a shipped Unity shader guarantee
